name: Bitbucket Cloud API
tagline: Git hosting, PRs, and CI/CD automation via Atlassian Bitbucket Cloud REST 2.0
description: Bitbucket Cloud REST API (v2.0) lets developers manage repositories, pull requests, pipelines, issues, and workspaces programmatically. Hosted at api.bitbucket.org; uses OAuth 2.0, API tokens, or access tokens. Free tier available with plan-based rate limits.

auth.details: API tokens (Basic auth with Atlassian email + token), OAuth 2.0, workspace/project/repo access tokens; app passwords deprecated/retired 2025–2026

pricing.free_tier_limits: Free Bitbucket plan includes API access; rate limit default 1,000 req/hour (product free: 5 users, 1 GB storage, 50 build min/mo)
pricing.paid_plans: Standard ~$3.65/user/mo; Premium ~$7.25/user/mo; scaled rate limits up to 10,000 req/hour for large Standard/Premium workspaces

rate_limits: Default 1,000 requests/hour; Standard/Premium with 100+ paid users and access tokens/Forge: +10 req/hour per paid user, capped at 10,000/hour
use_cases: create or update a pull request
trigger or check Bitbucket Pipelines build status
get commit history for a repository
